nodes.label: SafetyStateMachineTest.kt
SafetyStateMachineTest
.`vacuum start requires cover open`()
.`full vendor 7-step vacuum workflow climbs every confidence tier`()
.`a single cap-wait sample does not start monitoring`()
.`the hold starts on stable pressure when the cover byte never arrives`()
.`a shell that gives back too much after the pump keeps waiting`()
.`two ambient readings during the cap wait step back to Unknown quietly`()
.`motor timeout stops the motor and closes the solenoid`()
.`gross leak fails within ten seconds instead of five minutes`()
.`pressure back at surface ambient acts on the second agreeing sample`()
.`a depressurisation inside the hard verify fails even from Passed`()
.`venting a freshly pumped hold early is a failure, not a release`()
.`cancel from every seal state stops the motor and closes the solenoid`()
.`reset never leaves the seal passed and drives hardware to rest`()
.`surface ambient is captured while the cover is open`()
.`surface ambient is not captured while the shell is sealed`()
.`surface ambient is not captured while a vacuum is held with the cover open`()
.`surface ambient is not captured while the pump is running`()
.`skip to result keeps the tier already reached`()
.`skip to result below the provisional tier reports uncertainty rather than a pass`()
.`skip to result outside monitoring does nothing`()
.`dismiss silences the prompt and opening the cover restores it`()
.`a repeated cover-open notification does not disturb an in-flight pump`()
.`opening the cover voids a passed verdict and stops monitoring`()
.`confidence tiers map to the published hold times`()
.`thresholds clear the barometric sensor resolution`()
.`a deep vacuum the machine never pulled is adopted into leak monitoring`()
.`a shallow drop is not mistaken for an established vacuum`()
.`without a captured baseline the fallback threshold is stricter`()
.`a held vacuum with a stale open cover byte is detected, not self-poisoned`()
.`a vented shell still captures surface ambient when the sensors agree`()
.`a leak inside the hard verify window is a failure with an alert`()
.`a vent after the hard verify is treated as deliberate, not a failure`()
.`a deliberate release at the surface raises the released banner, not the doorway`()
.`a deliberate release below the surface never offers to open the housing`()
.`the released banner lets the pump start despite a stale cover byte`()
.`a capped pump is stopped within seconds, not left grinding`()
.`a pump that pulled real suction and then stalled is stopped within a rate window`()
.`a slow but healthy pump is never mistaken for a leak`()
.`an adopted vacuum raises the close-the-cap reminder`()
.`a shell draining through vacuum levels on its way to ambient is never adopted`()
.`a persisted verified reading that still matches restores earned trust at boot`()
.`a persisted start time restores the true hold duration, not the tier floor`()
.`a persisted reading that no longer matches is a restart seal failure`()
.`a boot record refuted at ambient is a restart seal failure, confirmed by two readings`()
.`one glitched sample cannot end a healthy hold`()
.`two agreeing ambient readings still end the hold as a vent`()
.`venting an adopted vacuum is deliberate even minutes after adoption`()
.`a drifting adopted seal still fails red`()
.`a hair-fine slow leak fails the seal inside the certification window`()
.`after the hard verify the decay limit is thermal-tolerant but still catches real loss`()
.`the decay watch stands down while the housing is submerged`()
.`a dive-cycle cool-down and warm-up never reads as decay`()
.`a failed seal is not resurrected by pressure alone`()
